subject: "Application is paused" notification in study 3712 for participant 95653
body:
Hi Micah
I hope you have a wonderful day.
This is Amin from Avicenna tech team.
We have been investigating the "Application is paused" notification in study 3712 for participant 95653 issue you brought to us and found the root cause. The solution to that problem is a complex one and requires optimizations on multiple layers of the app. We've added the necessary tasks to our roadmap but unfortunately the fix will not be ready in matter of days as it's not as easy as we hoped it would be. This issue will gradually be fixed as we're working on it. Since the issue is isolated to a single participant, we hope it doesn't hamper your research.
Best regards,
Amin

Note: If you feel like your issue is not properly being addressed and want to escalate it, please click here: https://avicennaresearch.com/app/public/zammad/escalate/25528/d302e9af871558f4

subject: Re: "Application is paused" notification in study 3712 for participant 95653
body:
Hi Amin,

Thanks so much for the update. I’m very glad to hear you’ve identified the issue and a fix is in the works.

To be clear though, this issue was not isolated to a single participant. It has affected literally every participant I’ve spoken to with an iPhone across two separate studies. I can provide their participant IDs as well if that is useful.

In any case I’ll stay tuned for updates. Thanks again!

- Micah



Micah Kaats
Ph.D. Candidate in Public Policy
Harvard University
www.micahkaats.com
